entities.summary: Battle fought in 885 between the forces of the abbasid caliphate under abu'l-abbas ibn al-muwaffaq (the future caliph al-mu'tadid) and the autonomous tulunid ruler of egypt and syria, khumarawayh. Date: 885-04-05. Ended: 885-04-06.
